reviews.title: Pretty ok
reviews.text: A flight was quite ordinary. The seats were not extra comfortable, though. However, they fed us with a sandwich which was better than some other airlines have. The staff were quite polite but nothing special or any warm smiles/assistance.
reviews.author: Ira R

reviews.title: Bucharest - Kiev Flight
reviews.text: Before coming Dniproavia to the air transportation market there were no straight flights from Bucharest to Kiev. Dniproavia made it fast, easy and comparably cheap to get to Ukrainian capital form Bucharest. When I first found down about Dniproavia I looked forward to flying with it. At the moment when they started to sell tickets the price for flights was the same as for the train ticket Bucharest-Kiev. But the difference is that by train it's 27 h to get to Kiev and by plane just 1h 40 min. I've bought 3 round trips with this company. When flying firs time in May 2017 big sandwich and drinks were included into price. In November 2017 no drinks and no food was offered. There were some small problems with this company. As tickets was not emailed before to contact them by chat, was no possibility to make online booking. It's very pity that Driproavia is no longer operating! After Driproavia merged with WindRose ticket price quite increased.
reviews.author: _A4395UO

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: The plane from Ivano-Frankovsk was late by 30 minutes and the people from Dniproavia did not wait for us to connect the flight from Kiev to Sofia. Terribly disappointing. I would never travel in Ukraine and I will never use any poor servicea of their awful airlines. Please beware because it might happen to you too!
reviews.author: Don_Momchilio

reviews.title: Smallest Plane Ever?
reviews.text: Well, first of all, it was indeed the smallest plane I've ever been on. The ticket said I'd be flying Austrian Air, but then this happened. There were three seats per row. It was almost impossible for an adult to properly sit on a chair without either bumping his head, or breaking his knee caps. Also, it was quite noisy. At times I thought that there was no isolation whatsoever. Furthermore, the restroom cabin is super small, and it smells awfully. I was flying for a competition in Kiev. I hadn't even reached it, and I already felt as miserable as if I'd lost. What's more, a friend of mine, and a fellow contestant had an accident with the crew. The plane was so small that the steward couldn't turn around without spilling juice on her. And then water he was bringing her to clean her jeans. Here, I believe it was not the steward's fault, but rather the plane's design. I hope the other planes are not such "adapted private jets".
reviews.author: Nak K

reviews.title: Very good cheap & confortable flight
reviews.text: Very good plane (Embraer 145) even small, but very comfortable and with a good space between the seats row. The personnel is very friendly and the food they serve is decent. Very good beverages. I recommend for a cheap and comfortable flight
reviews.author: Marilena IAUTA

reviews.title: So far good experience
reviews.text: I didn't fly myself but my husband left with warm feeling towards this fly. There was no deley, no problem with check in. He received some food and drinks on the plane. Another nice aspect is that the luggage max. 20 kg is already included into the ticket price. I mean so far, it was a good experience.
reviews.author: Nadiia P

reviews.title: avergae
reviews.text: Very average airline offering high cost on short haul flights. No meals, no service. Threy use low cost operational model but charge much more :(. The only one reason to fly - monopoly :(
reviews.author: Petro S

reviews.title: Short flight, good service
reviews.text: Very convenient schedule, friendly staff, perfect flight. Dniproavia can be recommended and I will come again.
reviews.author: Peter B
